A UserControl that wraps an AvalonDock DockingManager to provide IDE-style floating, pinnable, and tear-off panes for the Trading and Strategy workspace shells. Key surface: LoadPage — adds or activates a FrameworkElement in a named document pane. SaveLayout — serialises the current dock layout to XML. LoadLayout — restores a previously serialised layout. Drag-and-drop page-tag protocol is preserved: drop a string tagged with SplitPaneHostControl.PageTagFormat to call LoadPage.
